colophon: Thus ends the armor of the Goddess, composed by Hari, Hara, and Brahma, in the Sri Varaha Purana.

lines.1: Of this Chandi Kavacha: the seer is Brahma; the meter is anushtubh;
lines.2: the deity is Chamunda; its seed, the Mothers named in the placing on the limbs;
lines.3: its essence, the deities who seal the directions; its use: recitation, for the pleasure of Sri Jagadamba.
lines.6: Om. That which is most secret in the world, giving every protection to human beings,
lines.7: which has never been told to anyone: tell it to me, O Grandfather.
lines.9: There is, O sage, a most secret thing, a help to all beings:
lines.10: the holy armor of the Goddess. Listen to it, great sage.
lines.12: third, Chandraghanta; Kushmanda is the fourth;
lines.14: seventh, Kalaratri; and Mahagauri the eighth;
lines.15: ninth, Siddhidatri: these are proclaimed the nine Durgas.
lines.16: These names were spoken by the great-souled Brahma himself.
lines.17: One being burned by fire, one surrounded by enemies in battle,
lines.18: those in rough and impassable places, terrified, who have gone to her for refuge:
lines.19: to them no misfortune comes in the peril of battle;
lines.20: I see no calamity for such a one, no grief, sorrow, or fear.
lines.21: Those who remember her with devotion surely gain success;
lines.22: those who remember you, O queen of the gods, you protect without doubt.
lines.23: Chamunda seated on a corpse, Varahi riding a buffalo,
lines.24: Aindri mounted on an elephant, Vaishnavi seated on Garuda,
lines.25: Maheshvari mounted on a bull, Kaumari riding a peacock,
lines.26: Lakshmi, the goddess seated on a lotus, lotus in hand, beloved of Hari,
lines.27: the goddess Ishvari, white in form, riding a bull,
lines.28: Brahmi mounted on a swan, adorned with every ornament:
lines.29: these are all the Mothers, endowed with every power of yoga,
lines.30: resplendent with many ornaments, shining with many jewels.
lines.31: The goddesses are seen mounted on chariots, full of wrath,
lines.32: bearing conch, discus, mace, spear, plough, and pestle,
lines.33: shield and lance, axe and noose,
lines.34: javelin, trident, and the supreme bow Sharnga.
lines.35: For the destruction of the bodies of the daityas, for the fearlessness of devotees,
lines.36: and for the good of the gods, they bear their weapons thus.
lines.37: Salutation to you, O most fierce one, of terrible valor,
lines.38: O mighty one, full of great energy, destroyer of great fear.
lines.39: Save me, O Goddess, hard to look upon, who swell your enemies' fear.
lines.40: In the east may Aindri protect me; in the southeast, the goddess of fire;
lines.41: in the south, Varahi; in the southwest, the Sword Bearer;
lines.42: in the west may Varuni guard me; in the northwest, she who rides the deer;
lines.43: in the north, protect me, O Kauberi; in the northeast, the Trident Bearer;
lines.44: above may Brahmani guard me, and below, Vaishnavi.
lines.45: Thus may Chamunda, who rides a corpse, guard the ten directions.
lines.46: May Jaya stand before me, and Vijaya stand behind;
lines.47: Ajita at my left side, and Aparajita at the right.
lines.48: May the Radiant One guard my topknot; Uma, stationed on the crown of my head;
lines.49: the Garland Wearer, my forehead; may the Glorious One guard my brows;
lines.50: the Three-Eyed One, between them; Yamaghanta, my nose;
lines.51: Shankhini, between my eyes; Dvaravasini, my ears;
lines.52: may Kalika guard my cheeks; Shankari, the roots of my ears;
lines.53: Sugandha, within my nose; Charchika, my upper lip;
lines.54: Amritakala, my lower lip; Sarasvati, my tongue.
lines.55: May Kaumari protect my teeth; Chandika, the middle of my throat;
lines.56: Chitraghanta, my uvula; Mahamaya, my palate.
lines.57: May Kamakshi guard my chin; Sarvamangala, my speech;
lines.58: Bhadrakali, my neck; the Archer, my spine;
lines.59: Nilagriva, the outside of my throat; Nalakubari, my windpipe;
lines.60: may the Sword Wielder protect my shoulders; the Thunderbolt Bearer, my arms;
lines.61: may the Staff Bearer guard my hands, and Ambika my fingers;
lines.62: may Shuleshvari protect my nails; Naleshvari, my belly;
lines.63: may Mahalakshmi, destroyer of the mind's grief, guard my breasts;
lines.64: Lalita Devi, my heart; the Trident Bearer, my belly;
lines.65: may Kamini guard my navel; Guhyeshvari, my secret parts;
lines.66: Putana and Kamika, the organ of generation; Mahishavahini, the anus.
lines.67: May Bhagavati guard my hips; Vindhyavasini, my knees;
lines.68: Mahabala, granter of every desire, is named for my shins.
lines.69: Narasimhi, my ankles; Amitatejasi, my feet;
lines.70: may Shri guard my toes; Talavasini, the soles beneath them.
lines.71: Damshtrakarali, my nails; Urdhvakeshini, my hair;
lines.72: Kauberi, my pores; Vagishvari, my skin.
lines.73: Parvati, my blood, marrow, grease, flesh, bone, and fat;
lines.74: Kalaratri, my entrails; Mukuteshvari, my bile;
lines.75: Padmavati, the lotus sheath; Chudamani, my phlegm;
lines.76: Jvalamukhi, the gleam of my nails; Abhedya, the Unbreakable, all my joints.
lines.77: May Brahmani guard my semen; Chhatreshvari, my shadow;
lines.78: protect my ego, mind, and intellect, O you who walk in dharma.
lines.79: Prana and apana, and vyana, samana, and udana:
lines.80: may the Thunderbolt-Handed guard them; Kalyanashobhana, my life-breath.
lines.81: In taste, form, smell, sound, and touch, Yogini;
lines.82: sattva, rajas, and tamas, may Narayani ever guard.
lines.83: May Varahi protect my life span; may Vaishnavi protect my dharma;
lines.84: my fame, renown, and fortune, my wealth and learning, the Discus Bearer.
lines.85: May Indrani guard my family line; protect my cattle, O Chandika;
lines.86: may Mahalakshmi guard my sons; may Bhairavi protect my wife.
lines.87: May Supatha guard my path, and Kshemakari, my road;
lines.88: Mahalakshmi at the king's gate; Vijaya, stationed everywhere.
lines.89: Whatever place is left without protection, not covered by the armor,
lines.90: protect all of it for me, O Goddess, Jayanti, destroyer of sin.
lines.91: One should not take a single step without the armor, if one wishes one's own good;
lines.92: covered always by the armor, wherever one goes,
lines.93: there one gains one's aim, and victory that fulfills every desire;
lines.94: whatever desire one desires, that one surely obtains;
lines.95: such a person attains on earth supreme, incomparable sovereignty.
lines.96: The mortal becomes fearless, unconquered in battles;
lines.97: covered by the armor, a person is honored in the three worlds.
lines.98: This armor of the Goddess is hard to obtain even for the gods.
lines.99: Whoever recites it, disciplined, every day at the three junctions, full of faith,
lines.100: gains a portion of the divine, and is unconquered in the three worlds;
lines.101: he lives a full hundred years and more, free from untimely death.
lines.102: All diseases perish, spider bites, boils, and the rest,
lines.103: and every poison, from plants or creatures, or made by human hands.
lines.104: All black magic, all mantras and yantras on earth,
lines.105: beings that walk the earth, fly in the sky, or live in water, spirits sent by instruction,
lines.106: afflictions inborn and hereditary, scrofulous swellings, shakinis and dakinis,
lines.107: the terrible dakinis of great strength who roam the mid-air,
lines.108: seizing planets, ghosts, and pishachas, yakshas, gandharvas, and rakshasas,
lines.109: brahma-rakshasas, vetalas, kushmandas, bhairavas, and the rest:
lines.110: they perish at the very sight of one who holds this armor in the heart.
lines.111: The king's honor rises; it is the supreme increaser of radiance.
lines.112: Such a person grows in fame across an earth adorned with his renown.
lines.113: Let one recite the Saptashati, the Chandi, having first recited the armor.
lines.114: As long as the earth bears its mountains, woods, and forests,
lines.115: so long his line of sons and grandsons endures upon the earth.
lines.116: At the body's end, the supreme state, hard to reach even for the gods,
lines.117: that person attains forever, by the grace of Mahamaya.
lines.118: He attains the supreme form, and rejoices with Shiva.
